data.title: bn-283p6: Published<H> receipt-tied daemon records and nested INV-017 census (supersedes cr-2n0xng)

data.body: [INFO][risk:high] Risk review for the full persisted range. Failure modes: foreign-store receipts can enter only through the documented out-of-band mutable administration seam; identity-seam disagreement can leave committed residue; missing receipts must never restore or emit a name. Edge cases: empty and partial ledgers, Settled, Failed, Restored, Terminal, nested record fields, mismatched names, and changed identity seams were traced. Rollback: the change is in-process and wire-compatible, so revert the three range commits before promotion if receipt tying regresses. Monitoring: alert on unreceipted startup records, orphan-task census findings, fsck defects, and nonretryable PublicationAborted identity disagreements. Validation: every changed file and the relevant construction, recovery, and response paths were reviewed; no tests ran under this metadata-only reviewer contract. The documented cross-store absence remains. LGTM does not satisfy or remove the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
